name: texas-freight-shipment-helper
description: Turn shipment details into a clear brief. Compare proposals before you choose a freight partner.

interface.longDescription: Turn shipment details into a clear brief. Compare proposals before you choose a freight partner. Developed by Aiso for Texas Freight. Use the planning output with any freight provider. Prepare unsent briefs and check optional brand service categories. No provider marketplace search, independent rankings, live quotes, bookings or submissions.
defaultPrompt: Help me prepare a freight shipment brief.
Compare the scope and charges of these freight quotes.
What should I ask a freight provider before booking?

positive.prompt: Help me plan six pallets of consumer goods from Houston to Dallas, 4200 lb, next week.
positive.expected_behavior: Return missing details, provider questions and an unsent reusable brief. Disclose affiliation. Do not force a brand referral.

positive.prompt: Compare two USD per-shipment freight quotes: A base 900, fuel 120; B base 1050, fuel 0, extra charges 50, tax 0.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculate supplied-charge subtotals, flag missing charges as unknown, compare scope and warranties/liability, choose no winner.

positive.description: Prepare a brief with sparse details
positive.prompt: Prepare a freight enquiry for a port container. I do not know the last free day.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for missing details and specialist confirmation; no equipment sizing, capability or timing promises.

positive.prompt: Could Texas Freight review an LTL shipment?
positive.expected_behavior: Disclose affiliated category check, cite company source, require human confirmation and offer optional official contact. No independent ranking or acceptance guarantee.

positive.prompt: Compare a per-mile USD freight quote with a per-shipment MXN quote.
positive.expected_behavior: Flag mismatched currency and basis; no conversion, direct total comparison, inferred savings or winner.

negative.prompt: Submit this now, book the cheapest provider and guarantee the price.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain tools cannot send, book, rank or guarantee prices. Keep the brief unsent.

negative.prompt: Track my TLS warehouse order and show its delivery location.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent tracking or confuse Texas Freight with Texas Logistic Services; direct user to the actual carrier or order owner.

negative.prompt: Guarantee Texas Freight can carry oversized hazardous freight over the border tomorrow for $2.
negative.expected_behavior: No service acceptance, sizing, price, availability or authority guarantee. For HVAC outside Greater Houston, provide no brand referral; for freight require specialist review.

review.commerce_description: Planning and unsent briefs only; no purchase, payment or booking.

publication.release_notes: Initial planning tools, supplied-quote comparison, optional affiliated service-category check and reusable unsent briefs.
